title: Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO Details
intro:
Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO is a book build issue of ₹35.93 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 50.61 lakh shares of ₹35.93 crore.

Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO opens for subscription on Sep 28, 2026 and closes on Sep 30, 2026. The allotment for the Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 1, 2026. Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 6, 2026.

Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO is set issue price band at ₹65 to ₹71 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,27,200 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,40,800.

Expert Global Consultants Pvt.Ltd. was the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. was the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in November 2016 (originally established as a partnership firm in April 1994), Acme Universal Safezone 9 Limited is a leading manufacturer of industrial safety footwear under the 'ACME' brand. The company operates in the Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) segment, manufacturing and supplying a wide range of safety shoes for industries such as construction, oil & gas, mining, automotive, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, foundries, and power generation. Its product portfolio includes EVA-Rubber, Nitrile Rubber, and PVC safety footwear compliant with Indian and international standards including IS 15298, EN ISO 20345, ASTM F2413, and SEDEX SMETA.

The company operates five manufacturing facilities across Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh, supported by advanced manufacturing technologies, SAP S/4 HANA ERP, ICad3D product design, CRM, and HRMS platforms. It serves customers through institutional sales, an extensive distributor and dealer network, e-commerce channels, and exports its products to several international markets including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Nigeria, Israel, the Netherlands, Hong Kong, Cameroon, and Mauritius.
The company focuses on technology-driven manufacturing, product innovation, international quality standards, and expanding its domestic and global footprint.
As of March 31, 2026, Acme Universal Safezone 9 employed 1,073 professionals across operations, sales, marketing, finance, HR, and IT functions.
strengths: Large-scale manufacturing capabilities with five production facilities.
Automated manufacturing supported by advanced ERP and design technologies.
Diversified safety footwear portfolio compliant with global quality standards.
Strong domestic distribution network, export presence, and long-standing customer relationships.

faqs.question: How to apply in Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
